description: Returns a collection of Company Checklist Templates for a specified Company.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[inspection_type_id]
parameters.description: Array of Inspection Type IDs. Return item(s) associated with the specified Inspection Type IDs.

parameters.name: filters[response_set_id]
parameters.description: Array of Item Response Set IDs. Return list template(s) whose items are associated with the given Response Set IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:

id.description: Unique identifier for the checklist template.
Unique identifier for the inspection type.

source_id.description: ID of the global inspection type this type was derived from. Null for types created directly for the company.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns this inspection type.

is_deletable.description: Whether the inspection type can be deleted. True when no active inspections or templates reference it.

grouping.description: Category grouping of the inspection type.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this trade was last updated.

deletable.description: Whether the checklist template can be deleted.
